name: query surface
claim: One hand-written GraphQL-subset query fetches any harness data (flows, turns, stems, handles, checkpoints, ledger, trail, catalog), and a model using it re-reads less than with separate read tools (docs/QUERY.md; extends query shape as the synopsis vtpcxq, select then fetch klsrrk, enumerable result set mvfezw).

models.result: n=59 queries (44 ok, 15 deliberate errors) over repo fixtures, the live catalog and synthetic handles: 116/118 determinism checks identical (59/59 on a fresh surface; the 2 others differ only by state changed by the first run). Versus output_read and entry_read on 8 equal needs with oracle offsets for the old route: 10813 tokens old, 5465 new. New is cheaper on 5 needs (ids of hypothesis concepts 2887 to 354; turn text 762 to 352; ledger columns 592 to 393; faults with text 525 to 397; one 30000-char turn 5832 to 3301) and dearer on 3 small known lookups (one concept claim 53 to 246; held or failed tool turns 40 to 207; trail rows 122 to 215). The 5832 to 3301 case is not like for like: get reached 12011 of 30000 chars (no continuation past getMax) while the old route reached all. Median time 0.2 ms per query.

n=8 tasks, 1 run each, 30 requests: 4 completed (T4, T6, T7, T8); 3 stopped at the 5-request cap after parse failures (T1, T2, T3); 1 wrong because the faults root served superseded records (T5, fault jtvyce). 23 queries and 8 refs; 4 queries re-ran an earlier root (mostly retries after a parse failure) against 8 refs used. 7598 tokens per task (prompt plus completion), 51725 prompt, 9059 completion of which 7534 reasoning, cost 0.0025 USD. n is tiny: a smoke probe, no rate is claimed.

name: result-set header
claim: A header leading every query result, listing deduped decorator attributes, kinds, labels, declared interactions and applied reducer, costs under a quarter of the result's tokens and lets the model act without further reads (docs/QUERY.md#2-result-set-header).

models.result: Target under 25% NOT met on this data. n=44 ok queries: header is 43.6% of result tokens overall (41.7% on queries that return data); 6 of 44 queries are under 25%, all of them with long payloads (long-session payload summary 15%, full payloads of fixture turns 18%, 100 concept ids 19%). The three worked examples are 69%, 81% and 66%. headerAttrs changed lowers the overall share to 37.9%. Header size is about 140 to 230 tokens per query regardless of data size, by part of header chars: kinds 32%, attrs 28%, refs 20%, pages 9%, reducers 4%, rest 7%. The descriptor of a materialized kind adds 39 tokens on the first query of a surface only.

n=8 tasks: the model read labels from the header and used them in query_ref calls in 3 tasks (T1, T2, T8: 8 refs, 7 accepted); it was not asked about header cost. No claim on acting without further reads beyond that.

name: kinds and labels
claim: Typing result entries as kinds whose labels are readable names, with per-kind capabilities and one payload-or-properties function, lets the model reference entries without opaque ids, with under 5% mis-referenced labels (docs/QUERY.md#3-kinds; contrast handles qvmztp).

models.result: n=8 refs in 3 tasks: 1 mis-referenced (12.5%): the model gave the root name as the label (q3/concepts, REF_UNKNOWN_LABEL). The target under 5% is not shown at this n (one miss moves the rate by 12 points). 7 refs resolved first try (labels like t0, x2, ids as labels).

Labels resolve in every battery case: 7 kinds (flow-turn, ledger-row, session, trail-row, checkpoint, handle, concept and others) across 44 ok queries; label collision or unknown-label only where the step asked for a wrong label (REF_UNKNOWN_LABEL exercised once on purpose). The 30000-char flow turn is reachable only through its label t14.

name: query-ref with declared interactions and staged intent
claim: Allowing only the get, set and property interactions a query's own header declared, inferred from the query shape and expiring with its scope, keeps follow-up actions bounded, and the model uses them instead of re-running queries (docs/QUERY.md#4-query-ref; extends entry_read and progressive exposure, tenets 21 and 38).

models.result: n=31 ref steps, 13 accepted, 18 refused: all 9 spec codes exercised (REF_FORMAT 2, REF_UNKNOWN_QUERY 2, REF_EXPIRED 2, REF_UNKNOWN_LABEL 1, REF_NOT_DECLARED 3, REF_BAD_NAME 4, REF_BAD_VALUE 2, REF_POLICY 1, REF_SOURCE 1). No refused ref reached the adapter (0 of 17 refusals other than REF_SOURCE, which by design calls it). Scopes: queries scope valid after 8 later queries and expired after 9; ticks scope valid after 2 ticks and expired after 3; surface scope valid after 30 queries and ticks; a second surface instance does not know the query. A policy deny on set added after the query is read at ref time. A get on a 30000-char turn returns 12011 chars and has no continuation (fault qhjhmv).

n=8 tasks: 8 refs used, 7 accepted, 1 mis-referenced label; 4 queries re-ran an earlier root, mostly retries after parse failures, so refs against re-runs is 8 to 4 on a sample too small to read as a rate. Refs were used to read payloads that the default summary had clipped (T1, T8) and a turn text (T2).

name: policy reducer hook
claim: A policy-chosen reducer applied at one hook, with the applied reducer named in the header, cuts payload tokens without hiding that reduction from the model, and text striping plugs in as a reducer (docs/QUERY.md#5-reducer-hook).

models.result: n=1 query, 12 turns of the long session with payload full, data tokens by reducer: none 1040, clip 200 673, clip 60 275, lines 2+1 697, omit 67. Each non-none reducer adds a header row (about 95 to 115 chars, header +58 to +61 tokens) naming it, with the clipped labels declared for get. A verbose false policy cut a get from 12011 to 215 chars. Text striping as a reducer was not measured.

name: data-source adapter seam
claim: A schema, resolve, label and get/set adapter lets the query layer run as a pure module with no DOM, proven by a mock source alone, with the harness adapter added as one file over injected sources (docs/QUERY.md#6-data-source-seam).

models.result: Two adapters merged in one surface (the harness adapter over injected fixture sources, and a scratch adapter with a settable kind, a failing source and a materialized kind) ran 59 queries and 31 ref steps in plain node with no DOM; the settable and materialized paths work only through the scratch adapter because the harness adapter declares none. One module defect in the harness adapter: faults and terms roots do not serve the supersedes-chain tail (fault jtvyce).
